blocking_decisions: Complete and approve the closed MC68060 semantic inventory and every multidimensional disposition row.
Freeze the complete fixed32 and extended instruction encoding without collisions or invented provisional opcodes.
Obtain an official ELF machine identifier and freeze the complete RELA relocation namespace.
Produce passing assembler, disassembler, compiler, linker, model, and RTL evidence against the frozen contract.
release_gate.semantic_rule: M64K-v1 is native 64-bit. MC68060 is a mandatory semantic audit baseline and never a binary, ABI, encoding, exception-frame, bus, or assembly-source compatibility claim.
